entries.purpose: Phase-1 Narrator voice sample for the cinematic narration proposal: opening slides 1, 2 and 5 (narrator), verbatim. Game-format clip (Ogg Vorbis).
entries.source: Synthetic speech rendered locally on the box on 2026-11-11 with Kokoro-82M v1.0 (hexgrad, Apache-2.0 weights and voice styles, https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) via kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 (MIT) and onnxruntime 1.31.1 on CPU; text verbatim from data/cinematics.json (main c104c06) with a pronunciation map for years applied to model input only; sentence-by-sentence synthesis with directed pauses and ffmpeg 7.1.5 mastering by generated_assets/audio/source/narration/render_vo.py (settings in voices.json and samples_render_log.json). No voice cloning, no real person's recording used, no cloud voice service.
entries.rights_status: AI-generated voice, NOT commercially cleared. Kokoro weights and voices are Apache-2.0, but its model card states the training data includes synthetic audio from closed commercial TTS models, and voice-level commercial questions are unanswered upstream (hexgrad/kokoro issues 219, 385, 388); ownership of AI output not settled. Phase-1 sample for voice-direction approval only; not for release.
entries.used_by: Not used by the game. Review sample for generated_assets/docs/narration/PROPOSAL.md (owner approval of voice direction and production approach).
entries.notes: Voice recipe narrator_a: Kokoro style mix {'am_michael': 0.7, 'bm_lewis': 0.3}, speed 0.88, lang en-us. Primary candidate. Kokoro voice-style blend 70% am_michael + 30% bm_lewis: mature baritone, measured. Mastering: soxr resample to 44.1 kHz, chain 'highpass=f=70,equalizer=f=180:t=q:w=1.0:g=1.0,equalizer=f=3500:t=q:w=1.2:g=1.0,acompressor=threshold=-22dB:ratio=2.2:attack=12:release=180:makeup=1', two-pass loudnorm to -18 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP. Measured on the delivered file: integrated -18.0 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dBTP, LRA 2.1 LU, 96 kbps mono. Slides joined with 1.1 s gaps. Bus 'Voice' is proposed (not in default_bus_layout.tres yet).
